worked_example.problem: A scientist at Limbe Botanic Garden studies how cocoa trees grow, and another studies the bacteria that make yoghurt. Which branches of biology are they using?

cards.idea: Biology is the study of living things: plants, animals, people and micro-organisms.
example: How a mango tree grows and how a goat digests grass are biology questions.

check.prompt: Which question is a biology question?

right.text: How do plants make their food?
How does the heart pump blood?

wrong.text: How fast does a car move?
What is table salt made of?

cards.idea: Biology has branches: botany (plants), zoology (animals), microbiology (micro-organisms), ecology, anatomy, physiology, genetics.
example: A zoologist studies animals such as gorillas in the forest.

cards.idea: Biology helps us stay healthy, grow food and protect nature, and leads to many careers.
example: A vet treats sick animals; an agronomist helps farmers grow better crops.

questions.prompt: Match each branch of biology with what it studies.

pool.right: how the parts of the body work
how features pass from parents to offspring

pick.why: An agronomist: helps farmers grow better crops.
A nurse: cares for patients in hospital.
A pharmacist: prepares and sells medicines.
A laboratory technician: tests blood and other samples.

misconceptions.explain: Not that career. Read what each person does.

pick.t: the bones of the human skeleton
pick.why: Anatomy: the bones of the human skeleton.

pick.t: how the kidneys clean the blood
pick.why: Physiology: how the kidneys clean the blood.

pick.t: why a child has her mother’s eyes
pick.why: Genetics: why a child has her mother’s eyes.
Microbiology: the bacteria that cause cholera.
Botany: the trees of the rainforest.

misconceptions.explain: Not that branch. Read what each branch studies.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Botany is the study of plants.
Zoology is the study of animals.
Ecology studies living things and their environment.

wrong.explain: Biology studies all living things: plants, animals, people and micro-organisms.

wrong.text: Genetics is the study of soils.
wrong.explain: Genetics studies how features pass from parents to offspring.
